(इ) श्रकि r. 1st cl. (श्रंकते)
To go.

(इ) स्रकि r. 1st cl. (स्रंकते)
To go.

(इ) श्रगि r. 1st cl. (श्रंगति)
To go, to move.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (श्रणति, श्राणयति) usually with वि prefixed, (विश्राणयति)
To give, to present.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Boiled, dressed, (any thing except butter, milk, or water.)
2 Moist, wet.
f. (-णा)
Rice-gruel.
E.
श्रै to cook, aff. क्त, form irr.

ind.
A particle and prefix implying belief or reverence.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (श्रथति, श्रथयति)
1 To hurt, to injure, to kill.
2 To let loose or discharge, to set free, to liberate.
3 To bind or tie.
r. 10th cl. (श्राथयति)
1 To apply diligently, to endeavour sedulously.
2 To delight frequently.
3 To march.
r. 10th cl. (श्रथयति)
To be weak or infirm.
(इ) श्रथि r. 1st cl. (श्रंथते)
1 To be loose or lax, to be slack or flaccid.
2 To let loose, to loosen.

n. (-नं)
1 Tying, stringing.
2 Loosening, untying.
E.
श्रथ to tie, &c., aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-धन्-धती-धत्)
Believing, having faith.
E.
श्रत्, and दधत् having.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Trusting, believing.
2 Venerating, respecting.
E.
श्रत् particle of faith or respect, धा to have, शानच् aff.

nf. (-द्धं-द्धा)
1 Respect, reverence.
2 Wish, desire.
3 Faith, belief.
4 Purity.
E.
श्रत् a particle implying belief, &c., धा to hold or have, aff. अङ् and टाप्.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Faithful, believing.
n. (-द्धं)
A funeral ceremony observed^1 at various fixed periods and for different purposes, consisting of offerings with water and fire to the gods and manes, and gifts and food to the relations present and assisting Brahmans; it is especially performed for a parent recently deceased, or for three paternal ancestors, or for all ancestors collectively, and is supposed necessary to secure the ascent and residence of the souls of the deceased in a world appropriated to the manes. The following distributions of this ceremony are specified; the पार्व्वणं in honor of three ancestors, एकोद्दिष्टं of one, नित्यं regular, नैमित्तिकं occasionally, काम्यं for the attainment of some particular object, आह्निकं daily, वृद्धिः for the obtaining of increase of prosperity, and सपिण्डनं in which the balls of meat offered to the deceased individually and collectively are blended together. There are many other kinds: those for a person recently deceased are one on the day after mourning expires, and twelve others in twelve successive months; one at the end of the third fortnight, one in the sixth month, and one in the twelfth, concluding with a Sapiṇḍana, on the anniversary of the person's death; in general they are all performed in the course of the two or three first days, and the Śrāddha for the deceased is only annually repeated. There is also a sort of Śrāddha performed daily during the days of mourning, usually ten, on which a funeral cake is presented, increasing one or more each day till ten cakes are offered.
E.
श्रद्धा faith, अण् or ण aff. of possession or relation, as the abandonment or presentation of meat, &c. through faith of its efficacy, in behalf of the souls of the deceased.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Done with faith.
E.
श्रद्धा, and कृत done.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Believing, faithful.
E.
श्रद्धा, and अन्वित endowed with; also श्रद्धासमन्वित.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Believing, full of faith.
E.
श्रद्धा, and मयट् aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Having faith, believing.
E.
श्रद्धा, and युक्त joined.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Distrusting, unbelieving.
E.
श्रद्धा, and रहित abandoned.

mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु)
1 Faithful, believing.
2 Wishing, desirous.
f. (-लुः)
A pregnant woman longing for any thing.
E.
श्रद्धा faith, आलुच् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Believing, trusting, having faith.
E.
श्रद्धा, and मतुप् aff.

r. 9th cl. (श्रथ्नाति)
1 To set free, to let loose, to liberate.
2 To gladden, to delight frequently.
3 To string, to tie together.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (श्रन्थति श्रन्थयति)
To arrange, to place in order.

m. (-न्थः)
1 Loosening, liberating.
2 Looesness, flaccidity.
3 Tying, binding, stringing.
4 A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
श्रन्थ to tie, &c., aff. अच्.

nf. (-नं-ना)
1 Stringing flowers, &c.
2 Killing, destroying.
3 Tying, binding.
4 Loosening, untying.
E.
श्रन्थ to tie or unite, aff. युच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Strung, connected, bound together.
2 Overcome, surpassed, overpowered.
3 Hurt, injured.
4 Loosed, let loose.
E.
श्रन्थ to tie, or श्रथि to hurt, &c., aff. क्त.

n. (-णं)
Boiling in a pot.
E.
श्रै to boil, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

ind.
Having boiled or dressed.
E.
श्रै to cook, causal v., क्त्रा aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Boiled, (any thing except water, milk or Ghee.)
f. (-ता)
Rice-gruel.
E.
श्रै to cook or boil, causal v., aff. क्त.

(ञि इर, उ) श्रमु r. 4th cl. (श्राम्यति)
1 To perform acts of austere devotion, to undergo mortification or penance.
2 To be wearied or fatigued.
3 To be distressed.

m. (-मः)
1 Military exercise.
2 Weariness, fatigue.
3 Labour, exertion, toil.
E.
श्रम to be wearied, aff. अच्.

r. 10th cl. (श्रामयति)
1 To call, to summon, to invite.
2 To counsel, to advise.

m. (-मः)
1 A month.
2 A temporary shed, or platform and canopy.
3 Time.
E.
श्रम to be weary, अण् aff.

n. (-लं)
Perspiration from exertion or fatigue.
E.
श्रम, and जल water.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Following a low or degraded business or profession.
2 Base, vile, bad.
m. (-णः)
1 A religious character, an ascetic, a Yati, one devoted to meditation for the purpose of obtaining final emancipation from existence, probably the Sarmanes of the Greek writers.
2 A beggar, the religious mendicant.
f. (-णा or णी)
1 Indian spikenard, (Valeriana Jatamansi.)
2 Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.)
3 A handsome woman.
4 A woman of low caste or business.
5 A female mendicant.
E.
श्रम to be wearied, aff. युच्.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Accomplished by labour or exertion.
E.
श्रम, and सिद्ध accomplished.

mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं)
Exhausted, overcome with fatigue.
E.
श्रम, and आर्त्त pained.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
1 Wearying, tiring, undergoing or incurring weariness or fatigue.
2 Laborious, diligent.
E.
श्रम to be weary, aff. घिनुण्.

(उ) श्रम्भु r. 1st cl. (श्रम्भते)
To be careless or inattentive, to err, to neglect, to mistake.

(उ) स्रम्भु r. 1st cl. (स्रम्भते)
To trust, to have faith or confidence in.

m. (-यः)
Asylum, refuge, protection.
E.
श्रि to serve, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Sacred or belonging to the goddess ŚRĪ.
m. (-यः)
Refuge, reliance, shelter or protection.
E.
श्रि to serve, aff. अण्, or in the attributive form श्री the goddess, घञ् aff., and इ substituted for the primitive vowel changed to अय, and अ made long.

n. (-णं)
Asylum, refuge, shelter, protection.
E.
श्रि to serve, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be defended or sheltered.
E.
श्रि to serve, अनीयर् aff.

m. (-वः)
1 The ear.
2 Oozing, dripping.
E.
श्रु to hear, &c., aff. अप्; also श्रवण, स्रव, &c.

m. (-वः)
Oozing, dropping, flowing.
E.
श्रु to ooze, aff. घञ्.

m. (-वः)
1 Oozing, dropping, trickling, flowing, the gradual issue or progress of any fluid.
2 A fountain.
f. (-वा)
A plant, (Sanseviera zeylanica.)
E.
स्रु to flow or drop, aff. अप्.

m. (-वः)
Oozing, flowing, dripping.
E.
स्रु to go or flow, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Produced in or under the sign ŚRAVAṆĀ.
mn. (-णः-णं)
1 The ear.
2 Hearing.
n. (-णं)
1

Service.
2

Dripping, oozing.
mf. (-णः-णा)
The twenty-third of the lunar asterisms, represented by three footsteps, and containing three stars or α, β and γ Aquilæ.
E.
श्रु to hear, &c., aff. ल्युट् or युच्; or श्रवणा the asterism, अण् aff. of derivation, and the effect rejected.

mfn. (-णः-णी-णं)
1 Produced in or under the asterism Śravaṇā.
2 Relating to the ear or hearing.
m. (-णः)
1 The month Śrāvaṇa or Śravaṇā, (July-August.)
2 A heretic, an impostor. []
n. (णं)
Causing to be heard.
f. (-णा)
A plant, commonly Katuki.
f. (-णी)
Day of full moon in the month Śrāvaṇa.
E.
श्रवणा the asterism, &c., aff. अण्.

n. (-णं)
1 Oozing, flowing, trickling.
2 Sweat, perspiration.
3 Piss, urine.
E.
स्रु to ooze, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-थः)
The ear.
E.
श्रवण, and पथ for पथिन् path.

m. (-री)
A speaker, an addresser.
E.
श्रवण, and अघिकारिन् connected with or acting on.

n. (-यं)
The organ of hearing, the ear.
E.
श्रवण, and इन्द्रिय organ of sense.

n. (-रं)
The hollow of the outer ear.
E.
श्रवण, and उदर belly.

n. (-वः)
The ear.
E.
श्रु to hear, aff. असुन्.

m. (-प्यः)
An animal fit or proper for sacrifice.
E.
श्रु to drip, (Ghee,) आप्य Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Produced in or under the sign ŚRAVIṢṬHĀ.
f. (-ष्ठा)
The twenty-fourth lunar asterism, also called DHANIṢṬHĀ, corresponding to the DOLPHIN.
E.
श्रव an ear, मतुप् poss. aff., इष्ठन् aff. of the superlative, and the possessive rejected; the attributive is formed by the aff. अण, and that again or its effect optionally rejected.

m. (-जः)
The planet MERCURY.
E.
श्रविष्ठा the asterism, and ज born.

r. 2nd cl. (श्राति)
1 To boil, to cook, to mature, to ripen, &c.
2 To sweat.
Causal form (श्रपयति)
To render mature or ripe by cooking, &c.
(श्रापयति)
To heat, to cause to sweat.

m. (-रः)
The offerer of an obsequial oblation.
E.
श्राद्ध, and कर who makes.

n. (-र्म्म)
The rite or ceremony of funeral oblation.
E.
श्राद्ध, and कर्म्मन् act; also श्राद्धक्रिया, &c.

m. (कृत्)
The celebrator of an obsequial rite.
E.
श्चाद्ध, and कृत् who makes.

m. (-दः)
The offerer of an obsequial rite.
E.
श्राद्ध, and द who gives.

m. (-वः)
YAMA.
E.
श्राद्ध the funeral ceremony called Śrāddha, and देव deity; as judge and monarch of the dead.

f. (-ता)
A divinity presiding over obsequial rites, a Pitṛ or progenitor, or YAMA.
E.
श्राद्ध, and देवता divinity.

mfn. (-भुक्)
Eating or partaking of the food prepared at a Śrāddha or obsequial rite.
E.
श्राद्ध, and भुज् who eats.

n. (-ष्टं)
Food that has been presented to the manes.
E.
श्राद्ध, and शिष्ट left.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 The object, receiver, or enjoyer of an obsequial oblation.
2 Anything relating to a Śrāddha.
E.
श्राद्ध as above, ठन् aff.

mfn. (-द्धी-द्धिनी-द्धि)
The object or receiver of a funeral oblation.
E.
श्राद्ध as above, इनि aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Wearied, fatigued.
2 Calmed, tranquil.
m. (-न्तः)
An ascetic, one with subdued passions.
E.
श्रम to be weary, aff. क्त.

n. (-नं)
Affording rest or relief to the weary, giving them seats, beds, &c.
E.
श्रान्त wearied, संवाहन relieving.

f. (-न्तिः)
Weariness, exhaustion.
E.
श्रम to be weary, क्तिन् aff.

m. (-रः)
A follower or disciple and servant of the principal Jainas or Jinas.

mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
Produced in or on the best, &c.
E.
श्रेयम् the best, अण् aff., and the form changed by special rule.

m. (-कः)
1 The lay votary of a Buddha or

Jina.
2

A crow.
E.
श्रु to hear, causal form, ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-कं)
Black-pepper.
E.
स्रु to ooze, causal form, खुल् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating to or produced in the month Śrāvaṇa.
m. (-कः)
The month Śrāvaṇa.
E.
श्रवणा the asterism in which the moon is full this month, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be declared or pronounced, to be made to be heard.
E.
श्रु to hear, causal v., अनीयर् aff.

f. (-न्ती)
A city, also Dharmapattan.
E.
श्र to ooze, causal form, भच् aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be declared, to be made to be heard.
E.
श्रु to hear, causal v., तव्य aff.

mfn. (-यः-यं)
Produced in or under the asterism ŚRAVIṢṬHĀ, relating to it, &c.
E.
श्रविष्ठा, and छण् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Spoken or read, caused to be heard.
E.
श्रु to hear, causal v., क्त aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 To be heard.
2 To be read or related, to be caused to be heard.
E.
श्रु to hear, ण्यत् aff., or causal v., and यत् aff.

(उ) स्रंसु r. 1st cl. (स्रंसते)
To fall down.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Falling, dropping, slipping off or down.
2 Fainting.
E.
स्रंस to fall, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Falling or hanging down, pendulous, depending.
m. (-सी)
A tree, commonly Pilu, and applied to several sorts, (as to Careya arborea, and Salvadora Persica, &c.)
E.
स्रंस to fall down, aff. णिनि.

m. (-लः)
A tree, (Mimosa Sirisha.)
E.
स्रंसिनी pendulous, and फल fruit.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Wearing a garland.
f. (-रा)
A species of the Prakṛti metre, a stanza of four lines of 21 syllables, and each line divided into three portions of seven syllables each.
E.
स्रज्, and धर who has.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Bearing a chaplet, &c.
f. (-विनी)
A species of Jagatī metre.
E.
स्रज् a garland, विनि aff.

f. (स्रक् or स्रग्)
1 A chaplet, a wreath of flowers worn over the forehead.
2 Any garland or string of flowers.
E.
सृज to quit, क्तिन् aff., and the vowel changed to its congener.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Covered with garlands, profusely decorated with chaplets, &c.
E.
स्रग्विन् having a garland, इष्ठन् aff. of the irr. superlative and the possessive termination dropped; also with ईयसुन् aff. of the same, स्रजीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः).

f. (-द्धूः)
A fart.
E.
शृध to fart, ऊ aff.; more properly श्रद्धू.

mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्)
1 Oozing, flowing.
2 Dropping, distilling.
f. (-न्ती)
1 A river in general.
2 The situation of the spleen, the left hypochondriac region.
3 A drug.
E.
स्रु to drop, participial aff. शतृ.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Perspiring much, covered with perspiration.
E.
स्रवत्, स्वेदजल perspiration.

f. (-र्ब्भा)
A woman or cow miscarrying by accident.
E.
स्रवत् falling, गर्ब्भ the foetus.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A fair, a market.
E.
स्रव moving, and द्रङ्ग a city.

m. (-ष्टा)
1 A creator, a maker.
2

BRAHMĀ.
3

ŚIVA.
E.
सृज to create, तृच् aff., form irr.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Fallen down, off, or from.
2 Separated, disjoined.
3 Loosened, relaxed, given way.
E.
स्रंस to fall, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Letting go, relaxing one's hold.
E.
स्रस्त, and हस्त the hand.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Having the limbs relaxed, swooning, fainting, falling.
E.
स्रस्त, and अङ्ग the body.

ind.
Quickly, instantly.
E.
स्रै to cook or ripen, क्विप् aff., स्रा maturity, अक् to obtain, क्विप् aff.
